info.title: Govia API Docs
info.description: Comprehensive REST API & Real-Time Socket documentation for the Govia platform.

bearerAuth.description: Enter your JWT Bearer token in the format: Bearer <token>

post.description: Authenticates a user with email, role, and password, returning JWT access and refresh tokens.
Verifies email address using the one-time code sent to the user.
Sends a password recovery verification OTP to the user email.

message.example: Please check your email. OTP has been sent.

post.description: Resets user password using the token provided in the Authorization header.

schema.description: Reset password payload using reset token in header

post.description: Changes password for the currently authenticated user.

schema.description: Change password payload for authenticated user

post.description: Uses refresh token to generate a fresh JWT access token.
Registers a new user account with role-specific details.

200.description: User registered successfully. OTP sent to email.

400.description: Bad request or email already exists

get.description: Retrieves current authenticated user profile details.

patch.description: Updates profile information and avatar image of the current user.

get.description: Admin endpoint to list all users with role filtering and pagination.

post.description: Schedules a future Zoom meeting. Open to ALL roles. If conversationId is provided, it syncs with chat.

get.description: Returns meetings where the user is host, invitee, or joined attorney with timeFilter and status filters.

post.description: Instantly creates an active Zoom consultation meeting. Open to all roles.

schema.description: Start instant Zoom consultation meeting payload

post.description: Triggered by Citizens during an encounter to instantly start an emergency call and notify attorneys.

patch.description: Ends active meeting, sets status to COMPLETED, fetches Zoom cloud recordings, and replaces "Join Now" with recording playback.
Synchronizes Zoom cloud recordings to MongoDB if processing finished after call conclusion.

post.description: Sends a text message or file attachment to a conversation.

example.text: Hello, I have a question about my consultation.

post.description: Creates an instant or scheduled Zoom meeting directly within a conversation, generating a chat card and syncing to Schedule Page.

schema.description: Create instant or scheduled meeting from inside chat thread

201.description: Meeting created and posted to chat

get.description: Searches users by name, role, email with precomputed direct conversation IDs for 1-click messaging.

post.description: Click-action on search result to retrieve existing conversation or create new thread atomically.

schema.description: Click-to-chat payload with target user ID

get.description: Retrieves chronological chat history with populated meeting status and attachments.

patch.description: Marks unread messages in the thread as read and emits real-time read receipt.

get.description: Retrieves all conversations for the authenticated user with unread counts and last messages.
Retrieves conversation metadata and participant details.
Lists community resources with optional category filtering and search.
Retrieves complete details of a specific community resource.

post.description: Sends a prompt to Govia AI Assistant for legal guidance, encounter rights, and crisis assistance.

message.example: What are my rights during a traffic stop?

get.description: Retrieves all previous conversation threads with the AI Assistant.
Retrieves full message history of a specific AI chat thread.
Retrieves all hero highlights and testimonials.
Retrieves user recordings and encounter evidence files.
